{{Quote|Our ''blasters'' can't penetrate their ''shield'', but the droids are having ''no'' problem blasting us to shreds ''through'' it!|The sergeant describes the battle to Tano and Skywalker|<ref name="IJ" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''sergeant''' in the [[Gall planetary defense force|planetary defense force]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gall/Legends|Gall]] served during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="IJ" /> Between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Inside Job]]" takes place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which started in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', and depicts [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which she left during the events of "[[The Wrong Jedi]]," which took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] per {{FactFile2014|42|20 BBY 51-54|Jedi Temple bombing}}.</ref> during the war, a [[Battle of Gall (Clone Wars)|battle]] took place on Gall and the [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] was amongst those who commanded the forces that worked with the Republic and fought the Confederacy's [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]]. However, their forces were unable to penetrate the [[Unidentified deflector shield model|shields]] generated by the Separatists' [[Shielded Separatist craft|lead craft]], which protected the [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] they used.<ref name="IJ" />

The sergeant explained their problems to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and<ref name="IJ" /> his<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who then used [[jet-wing]] vehicles to penetrate the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and destroy the lead [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that carried the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], which allowed the defense forces to destroy the rest of the Separatist forces. The sergeant had light skin, [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and blond [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. During the battle, they made use of a pair of [[Binoculars/Legends|binoculars]] and wore a thick moustache and green [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="IJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The sergeant appeared in "[[Inside Job]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] written by [[Rik Hoskin]] and illustrated by [[Andres Ponce]] that was published by [[Titan Magazines]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.1|first issue of the sixth volume]] of the [[Star Wars Comic|'' Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic]] magazine series<ref name="IJ" /> on [[November 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="ReleaseDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.theforce.net/latestnews/story/New_UK_The_Clone_Wars_Comic_Announced_127300.asp|text=New UK The Clone Wars Comic Announced|author=Barrick, Mike|date=2009-04-11|work=[[TheForce.net]]|archivedate=20200812092247}}</ref>
